newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - HBO & Co upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - HBO & Co upgraded.

text.p: -- Hambrecht & Quist said it upgraded HBO & Co to strong buy from buy.
-- raised the 1997 earnings estimate to $1.61 a share from $1.57 a share.
-- set a 1998 estimate of $2.16 a share.
-- said HBO management is comfortable with earnings estimates in the range of $2.10-$2.15 a share for 1998.
-- said "with reasonable growth through acquisition and continued strong business trends, we would not be surprised to see EPS growth in the 50 percent range over the next two years."
-- said sees HBO on "cusp of a period of outstanding financial performance that will significantly exceed Street expectations."
-- HBO gained 1-3/8 to 71-1/2 in morning trading.
